About the role 

DekkoSecure is an international technology company with deep expertise in protecting highly sensitive and mission critical data. DekkoSecure's focus is building military-grade, end-to-end encrypted security workflow solutions for government, law enforcement agencies, defence primes, and the enterprise healthcare sector. Our product suite includes DekkoCORE, a highly secure platform for file sharing and collaboration, and DekkoDEMS, purpose-built for digital evidence management. As we scale, we are creating a dedicated Business Systems Analyst position to sit at the centre of our product, support, commercial and operations functions. 

The Business Systems Analyst is responsible for eliciting and documenting business and system requirements, analysing existing processes and data, and translating client and internal needs into clear functional specifications and improved system functionality. The role is the central reference point between platform users, the product and engineering teams, and the wider business, ensuring that changes to our systems and processes are well specified, tested and adopted. 

Key responsibilities 

We are seeking an engaging, organised and analytical individual with advanced written and verbal communication skills who can: 

 * Work with platform users, clients and internal teams to draw out what they need from DekkoSecure’s systems, pin those needs down precisely, and write them up as requirements that both the business and the engineering team can build against. 

* Engage with users and clients across the company’s Australian, Northern European and North American markets to elicit, formulate and document business and system requirements, and to analyse how the platform is used in each market. 

* Examine how work currently flows through the company’s support, onboarding and data-handling activities and build process and data maps that expose where the business loses time, drops information or breaks down. 

* Analyse client usage of the platform to identify adoption patterns, friction points and where users encounter difficulty or inefficiency, feeding these findings back to the product and engineering teams with recommendations for improvement. 

* Weigh the available options and put forward the process changes and system behaviour the business should adopt, ranking each recommendation by the value it returns and the number of users it affects. 

* Turn agreed requirements into functional specifications the product and engineering teams can build from, across both DekkoCORE and DekkoDEMS. 

* Apply data and process modelling techniques to design and document how information and processes flow across core business systems, establishing and maintaining a single source of truth. 

* Set the test plans and acceptance criteria each change has to pass and run that testing, so nothing reaches production or client use until it holds up against the agreed requirements. 

* Run analysis and implementation work as planned, costed and resourced initiatives using agile methods, including the programmes to consolidate the company’s systems and formalise its processes, and track them through to delivery. 

* Design and maintain reporting and forecasting dashboards that give leadership accurate, data-driven visibility of system and operational performance. 

* Create and maintain documentation, including internal standard operating procedures for staff and external user guides and Help Center content for clients. 

* Conduct training and structured walkthroughs of new and changed platform functionality for internal users and clients to support adoption and validate that delivered changes meet acceptance criteria. 

* Be the person the business turns to on how its systems and processes work, advising the product, support, commercial and operations teams when they need to make system or process decisions.

* A relevant tertiary qualification in information technology, business informatics, or a related cross-functional business and information technology discipline. A postgraduate qualification combining information technology and business is highly regarded. 

* Experience working in a start-up or scale-up environment in a client-facing role. 

* Willingness to undertake occasional international travel to Europe and North America for requirements gathering. 

* Ability to understand user and client needs and translate them into documented system and process requirements. 

* Demonstrated ability to translate user and client needs into documented system and product improvements within a software or SaaS environment. 

* Experience with CRM systems, document and collaboration platforms. 

* Competence in data and process modelling, and in producing clear system specifications and process documentation. 

* Experience preparing and delivering user training. 

* Strong stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical teams. 



Desirable

* Familiarity with project management methodologies (for example Agile) and supporting tools. 

* Experience supporting product roadmap decisions through structured feedback and analysis.

Supply Chain Analyst available in all states NSW, Qld, Vic, & WA.

At NEPEAN™ we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services and industrial manufacturing organisation. We have unique capabilities to deliver high value, innovative and sustainable solutions for the world’s leading mining, construction, and transport companies. Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries.

We service our customers through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay.

We are currently offering a fantastic opportunity for Supply Chain Analyst to be based at our WA Office. This role ensures the company’s supply meets the customers’ demand. Duties include overseeing the company’s supply chains, ensuring timely delivery and keeping the company on budget.

Key Responsibilities:
Initiate pre-project risk assessment/review and communicate findings to Key Stakeholders as applicable
Evaluate areas of supply chain operations that require improvement
Be involved in and where practical recommendations during tendering/estimating
Facilitate handover from Sales & conduct formal scope/contract review
Review existing design/build sequence aspects, communicate with Engineering & optimise, increase, or improve profitability throughout the lifetime of the project
Compile and facilitate a detailed P.E.P (project execution plan)
Produce and report all project scheduling and resource requirements ensuring adequate float and contingency for risk
Implement effective and accountable communication methods to relevant stakeholders (including but not limited to the client and key suppliers) to ensure clarity of understanding regarding the deliverables & expectations required
Produce cost tracking and variation communication methods in line with both internal & external reporting & cost capture requirements

Skills, Knowledge & Abilities:
Organisational and time management skills
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong attention to detail
Ability to work autonomously and as part of a team
Interpersonal and communication skills
Able to communicate with several departments to evaluate and improve operations

If you believe you have the right skills, experience and passion for succeeding in this role, please submit your cover letter and resume for consideration.

NEPEAN believes in diversity and is committed to providing Equal Employment opportunities for all applicants. We welcome applicants from all walks of life which also included various socio-economic, cultural, LGBTIQ, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds.

Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

About the Role
We are currently seeking an experienced Organisation and Methods Analyst to join our team and lead process improvement and organisational optimisation initiatives. This role is ideal for someone with a keen eye for operational efficiency, systems design, and change management who thrives in dynamic, cross-functional environments.
You will work closely with senior leadership, department heads, and operational teams to evaluate current organisational systems, structures, and methods—proposing changes that drive sustainable growth, resource optimisation, and enhanced service delivery.
Key Responsibilities
Analyse organisational systems, processes, workflows, and structures to identify inefficiencies, redundancies, or compliance issues.
Consult with internal stakeholders to understand existing challenges and gather input on improvement opportunities.
Develop detailed process maps, system diagrams, and documentation to visualise and communicate current state and proposed future state.
Evaluate performance data, reports, and job descriptions to identify gaps, bottlenecks, and risks.
Recommend actionable solutions to improve productivity, restructure workflows, enhance accountability, and support strategic goals.
Prepare and present proposals for changes to procedures, job functions, and resource allocation.
Assist with the implementation of new procedures or organisational structures, including issuing revised manuals and training documentation.
Monitor compliance with new procedures and assess their impact on performance and service outcomes.
Support change management efforts by facilitating stakeholder workshops, coaching team leads, and managing communication plans.
Collaborate with IT and HR teams where technology or staffing intersects with proposed organisational changes.
Essential Skills & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Organisational Development, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of experience in business analysis, process improvement, organisational development, or consulting.
Strong capability in mapping and redesigning workflows using tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, or BPMN tools.
Proficiency in gathering, interpreting, and presenting qualitative and quantitative organisational data.
Demonstrated ability to manage stakeholder relationships and facilitate workshops or interviews.
High-level written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate technical findings into actionable business insights.
Understanding of project management, change management, and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, Agile).
Desirable Qualifications & Certifications
Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt Certification
Prosci Change Management Certification
PRINCE2 or PMP Certification
Advanced Excel or Power BI skills for reporting and data analysis
What We Offer
Exposure to high-impact organisational transformation projects
A collaborative team environment that values innovation and insight
Career development opportunities and professional upskilling
Flexible working arrangements and a strong focus on work–life balance
Pay: AU$70,000.00 – AU$120,000.00 per year
